newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian GIMV to be floated at 2,000 bfr/share.
newsitem.headline: Belgian GIMV to be floated at 2,000 bfr/share.

text.p: Belgium's Flemish regional investment company GIMV will be listed on the Brussels stock exchange next month at an initial price of about 2,000 francs per share, De Financieel Economische Tijd said on Wednesday.
The newspaper said a consortium of banks and brokers led by KB Securities would manage the partial float of 14.8 percent of the company.
The Flemish government, which owns 85 percent of GIMV, decided last year it would float around 15 percent of its holding. The company said in March it expected to come to market in June.
Another 15 percent is already in private hands following a private placement in 1995.

GIMV's main interests include 33.5 percent of Belgian electronics firm Barco, a bourse darling, around 10 percent of engineering company BMT and a small interest in Nasdaq-listed printing software firm Xeikon.
It is also a shareholder in Europe's Easdaq growth stocks market.
